finalText:
The bug was an off-by-one error in the start index calculation. Pages are 1-indexed (page 1 is the first page), but the code was treating them as if they were 0-indexed by doing `page * perPage` instead of `(page - 1) * perPage`. This meant every page was shifted forward by one batch of items.

Changed line 7 from `const start = page * perPage;` to `const start = (page - 1) * perPage;`

All 5 tests now pass.
